name: ilyautov/humanizer-ru
description: A Russian text editing collection that removes bureaucratic style and template phrasing, checks meaning and facts, and applies 67 markers and 21 hard rules for clean Russian prose.
install: npx skills add ilyautov/humanizer-ru, or /plugin marketplace add ilyautov/humanizer-ru then /plugin install humanizer-ru@ilyautov-plugins, plus git clone and a CLI installer that asks where to install
